import re

def count_distinct_characters(string: str) -> int:
    # Extract only alphabetic characters from the input string
    alpha_chars = re.findall('[a-zA-Z]', string)
    
    # Convert all characters to lowercase to ignore case
    alpha_chars_lower = [char.lower() for char in alpha_chars]
    
    # Count the number of unique characters in the string
    unique_chars = set(alpha_chars_lower)
    
    return len(unique_chars)
